description: Read public YouTube data with Desearch. Set action and that action's arguments. search (query; optional type, upload_date, sort_by, duration, cursor): videos, Shorts, live streams, channels, and playlists that match a keyword; each result has a type. video (id): one video or Short by ID or URL, with its channel, counts, chapters, and caption languages. transcript (video_id; optional language): its captions as plain text and timestamped segments; a video without captions returns 404. comments (video_id; optional order, cursor): its top-level comments. channel (handle): one channel by handle or channel ID. channel_videos (handle; optional sort, cursor): the channel's videos. A video id from search or channel_videos can be passed to video, transcript, or comments. video, transcript, and channel return the item itself. List actions return { results, next_cursor, next }. For the next page, call again with the same action and target and cursor set to next_cursor, unchanged; next_cursor is null on the last page. A cursor lasts 24 hours.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same action and target, sent back unchanged. Omit it for the first page.

duration.description: search: video length. Applies to videos, not Shorts.

handle.description: channel, channel_videos: channel handle (with or without @) or channel ID (UC...), example: '@MrBeast'.

id.description: video: YouTube video or Short ID, or its full URL, example: 'dQw4w9WgXcQ'.

language.description: transcript: caption language code, example: 'en' or 'es'. Omit for YouTube's default track.

query.description: search: keyword or phrase, example: 'bittensor'. Use intitle:"..." for stricter title matching.

type.description: search: only this kind of result. Omit for mixed results.

upload_date.description: search: only videos uploaded in this window.

video_id.description: transcript, comments: YouTube video or Short ID, or its full URL.

name: youtube
title: YouTube
